A Roman antler crown gaming counter, probably dating 2nd-4th century AD. This is a Crummy type 4 counter, a variant of Kenyon type B. It is round and lathe turned, with a four concentric ring decoration on one side, all surrounded by V-shaped notches cut into the edge of the counter.
